# ADOFAI-IPC npm release provenance

The app installs `adofai-ipc@2.1.0` from npm with an exact version and frozen Bun lockfile. `source.json` pins its upstream commit, registry integrity, and SHA-256 inventory of the published package. `./scripts/run.sh ipc-check` verifies the installed package and generated contract. This directory contains provenance only; application imports use the installed package.
